svg.title: M-07 Feed-Node Hardware - Tape Measure Satellite Yagi
svg.desc: Rev A feed-node mechanical detail derived from O3-O6 Rev L.
svg.text: FOR REVIEW - SOURCE O3-O6 REV L
2M-DE | X = 13.500 FROM FRONT | ONE HOLE PER HALF
OPPOSITE STEEL TIPS AND 0.250 GAP ARE HIDDEN IN PVC.
HP ENDS ARE SHOWN; U-SHAPE / TUNING GEOMETRY ARE O7/O8.
MEASURE ACTUAL NODE CENTER SPACING; IT IS NOT THE STEEL-TIP GAP.
70-DE | X = 18.500 FROM FRONT | ONE HOLE PER HALF
OPPOSITE STEEL TIPS AND 0.250 GAP ARE HIDDEN IN PVC.
DIRECT FEED; NO HAIRPIN OR INTENTIONAL DC BRIDGE.
MEASURE ACTUAL NODE CENTER SPACING; IT IS NOT THE STEEL-TIP GAP.
FROM SCREW HEAD TOWARD NUT; ONE SCREW / NUT PER NODE, FOUR TOTAL.
COAX RING LUG: CENTER OR BRAID
70 cm: OMIT LAYER 4; KEEP THE SAME REMAINING ORDER.
LOCAL BARE PAD ONLY. DO NOT TIN ANY CLAMPED CONTACT SURFACE.
1. M-06 GAP / SPAN MUST PASS WITH TEMPORARY HOLDS.
2. MARK 0.250 +/- 0.062 OUTBOARD OF EACH PVC SURFACE.
3. CENTER ACROSS ACTUAL ~3/8 BLADE; MIRROR HOLES.
5. DEBURR BOTH FACES; PREPARE ONLY LOCAL BARE PAD.
6. START 1/2 SCREW; 3/4 ONLY IF ENGAGEMENT FAILS.
7. SHORTEST USABLE; >=2 FULL THREADS PAST NUT.
8. CLEAR OTHER HALF / BOOM / TIE / HP ROUTE (EXCEPT HOOK).
LEFT/RIGHT MAY REVERSE BEFORE ASSEMBLY IF CONSISTENTLY LABELED / RECORDED.
1. DRILL ONE HALF AT A TIME; REFIT / RECHECK M-06 GAP.
2. FINAL STATION / ST-2 END TIES FOLLOW ALL FOUR HOLES.
3. O6: BARE SCREW / WASHER / NUT FOR FIT ONLY.
4. O7: ADD LABELED COAX LUGS + 2 m HAIRPIN.
1. ALL DIMENSIONS IN INCHES. NODE PLANS / STACK ARE SCHEMATIC; COUPON FIT CONTROLS.
2. DO NOT DRILL PVC FOR FEED SCREWS; EACH SCREW CONTACTS ITS ASSIGNED HALF ONLY.
3. 2 m HAIRPIN STARTS FROM 8.500 in BARE #12 BLANK; FINAL SHAPE / TUNE BY O7/O8.
